1 Prep data

#Alternate Cues
alt_cue <- import("data/AlternateCues.csv")

exclude_subjects <- alt_cue %>%
  filter(block != 0) %>%
  group_by(id) %>% 
  summarize(acc = mean(1-error),
            N = n())

exclude_subjects <- exclude_subjects %>%
  filter(acc < 0.8)

exclude_subjects <- c(exclude_subjects$id, 201, 901, 902, 959, 975)

alt_cue <- alt_cue %>%
  group_by(id, block, trial) %>%
  slice(1) %>%
  filter(!id %in% exclude_subjects) %>%
  group_by(id, block) %>%
  mutate(trialgroup = ifelse(cycle == 1, 1, 0),
         trialgroup = cumsum(trialgroup),
         is_bivalent = ifelse(dim1 == 4 | dim2 == 4, 0, 1),
         prev_bivalent = lag(is_bivalent, 1),
         was_prev_error = lag(error, 1),
         prev_task = lag(task, 1),
         switch = ifelse(prev_task == task, 0, 1)) %>%
  group_by(id, block, trialgroup) %>%
  mutate(prev_bivalent = prev_bivalent[1]) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(id = factor(id),
         prev_bivalent_contr = factor(prev_bivalent),
         prev_bivalent_eff = factor(prev_bivalent),
         is_bivalent_contr = factor(is_bivalent),
         is_bivalent_eff = factor(is_bivalent),
         cycle = factor(cycle),
         cycle_helmert = cycle,
         switch_contr = factor(switch),
         switch_eff = factor(switch)) %>%
  filter(trialgroup != 1, block != 0) %>%
  group_by(id) %>%
  mutate(trial_cont = seq(1, n()), .after = trial) %>%
  group_by(id, prev_bivalent, is_bivalent, cycle) %>%
  mutate(time_M = mean(time[error == 0 & was_prev_error == 0]),
         time_SD = sd(time[error == 0 & was_prev_error == 0]),
         time_z = (time - time_M)/time_SD,
         time_outlier = ifelse(abs(time_z) >= 3, 1, 0),
         filter_correct = ifelse(error == 1 | was_prev_error == 1, 1, 0),
         time_log = log(time)) %>%
  filter(time_outlier == 0) 

nrow(alt_cue)
## [1] 40454

2 Contrast coding

contrasts(alt_cue$prev_bivalent_eff) <- c(-0.5, 0.5)
contrasts(alt_cue$is_bivalent_eff) <- c(-0.5, 0.5)
contrasts(alt_cue$switch_eff) <- c(-0.5, 0.5) #we don't use that anywhere really

helmert <- contr.helmert(3)

helmert[,1] <- helmert[,1] %>% rev()
helmert[,2] <- helmert[,2] %>% rev()

colnames(helmert) <- c("2_v_3", "1_v_23")

contrasts(alt_cue$cycle_helmert) <- helmert
model_RT_trial <- lmer(time_log ~ poly(trial_cont, 2) + (poly(trial_cont, 2)|id), 
                       control = lmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa"),
                       alt_cue %>% 
                         filter(error == 0))

summary(model_RT_trial)

alt_cue <- alt_cue %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(time_log_pred = predict(model_RT_trial, .)) #%>%


alt_cue$time_log_res <- NA
alt_cue$time_log_res[alt_cue$error == 0] <- residuals(model_RT_trial)

#here i'm getting subject intercepts
model_RT_trial_ranef <- coefficients(model_RT_trial)$id %>% 
  as.data.frame() %>% 
  rownames_to_column("id") %>%
  select(id, "(Intercept)") %>%
  rename(poly_m_s_int = "(Intercept)")

alt_cue <- alt_cue %>%
  left_join(model_RT_trial_ranef) %>% #adding subject intercepts to the dataset to later add this
  group_by(id, block) %>%
  mutate(time_log_res_w_s_int = time_log_res + poly_m_s_int,
         lag1_time_log_res_w_s_int = lag(time_log_res_w_s_int, 1),
         lag1_time_log_res = lag(time_log_res, 1),
         lag1_time_log = lag(time_log, 1))
## Joining with `by = join_by(id)`
subs <- alt_cue$id %>% unique() %>% head(5)

plt_rt_w_model <- ggplot(alt_cue %>% filter(id %in% subs), aes(x = trial_cont, y = time_log, color = block, group = interaction(id, block)))+
  geom_line(alpha = 0.5, lwd = 0.3)+
  geom_smooth(se = FALSE)+
  geom_line(aes(y = time_log_pred), color = "green")+
  scale_color_viridis_c(end = 0.8)+
  facet_grid(~id)+
  labs(x = "Continuous Trial", y = "log(RT)", title = "log(RT) with trend model, by subject")+
  theme_classic()+
  theme(legend.position = "none")

plt_rt_residuals <- ggplot(alt_cue %>% filter(id %in% subs), aes(x = trial_cont, y = time_log_res, color = block, group = interaction(id, block)))+
  geom_line(alpha = 0.5, lwd = 0.3)+
  geom_smooth(se = FALSE)+
  scale_color_viridis_c(end = 0.8)+
  facet_grid(~id)+
  labs(x = "Continuous Trial", y = "log(RT)", title = "Residual RTs, by subject")+
  theme_classic()+
  theme(legend.position = "none")

3 Data Aggregation by cycle

alt_cue_agg_ID <- alt_cue %>%
  group_by(id, is_bivalent_contr, prev_bivalent_contr, switch_contr, cycle) %>%
  summarize(RT = mean(time[filter_correct == 0], na.rm = TRUE),
            RT_log = mean(time_log[filter_correct == 0], na.rm = TRUE),
            Error = mean(error, na.rm = TRUE))
## `summarise()` has grouped output by 'id', 'is_bivalent_contr',
## 'prev_bivalent_contr', 'switch_contr'. You can override using the `.groups`
## argument.
alt_cue_agg <- alt_cue_agg_ID %>%
  normWS(s = "id", dv = "RT") %>%
  mutate(RT = DV_n) %>%
  normWS(s = "id", dv = "RT_log") %>%
  mutate(RT_log = DV_n) %>%
  normWS(s = "id", dv = "Error") %>%
  mutate(Error = DV_n) %>%
  group_by(is_bivalent_contr, prev_bivalent_contr, switch_contr, cycle) %>%
  summarize(RT_m = mean(RT, na.rm = TRUE),
            RT_ci_lower = get_ci(RT, RT_m)[1],
            RT_ci_upper = get_ci(RT, RT_m)[2],
            RT_log_m = mean(RT_log, na.rm = TRUE),
            RT_log_ci_lower = get_ci(RT_log, RT_log_m)[1],
            RT_log_ci_upper = get_ci(RT_log, RT_log_m)[2],
            Error_m = mean(Error, na.rm = TRUE),
            Error_ci_lower = get_ci(Error, Error_m)[1],
            Error_ci_upper = get_ci(Error, Error_m)[2]
  )
## `summarise()` has grouped output by 'is_bivalent_contr', 'prev_bivalent_contr',
## 'switch_contr'. You can override using the `.groups` argument.
alt_cue_contr_agg_ID <- alt_cue %>%
  group_by(id, is_bivalent_contr, prev_bivalent_contr, switch_contr) %>%
  summarize(RT = mean(time[filter_correct == 0], na.rm = TRUE),
            RT_log = mean(time_log[filter_correct == 0], na.rm = TRUE),
            Error = mean(error, na.rm = TRUE))
## `summarise()` has grouped output by 'id', 'is_bivalent_contr',
## 'prev_bivalent_contr'. You can override using the `.groups` argument.
alt_cue_contr_agg <- alt_cue_agg_ID %>%
  normWS(s = "id", dv = "RT") %>%
  mutate(RT = DV_n) %>%
  normWS(s = "id", dv = "RT_log") %>%
  mutate(RT_log = DV_n) %>%
  normWS(s = "id", dv = "Error") %>%
  mutate(Error = DV_n) %>%
  group_by(is_bivalent_contr, prev_bivalent_contr, switch_contr) %>%
  summarize(RT_m = mean(RT, na.rm = TRUE),
            RT_ci_lower = get_ci(RT, RT_m)[1],
            RT_ci_upper = get_ci(RT, RT_m)[2],
            RT_log_m = mean(RT_log, na.rm = TRUE),
            RT_log_ci_lower = get_ci(RT_log, RT_log_m)[1],
            RT_log_ci_upper = get_ci(RT_log, RT_log_m)[2],
            Error_m = mean(Error, na.rm = TRUE),
            Error_ci_lower = get_ci(Error, Error_m)[1],
            Error_ci_upper = get_ci(Error, Error_m)[2]
  )
## `summarise()` has grouped output by 'is_bivalent_contr', 'prev_bivalent_contr'.
## You can override using the `.groups` argument.

All of the models work and aren’t singular. So we base the decision on which factors to combine now on the anova results.

alt_cue_error_contr_baseline <- xfun::cache_rds({
  glmer(error ~ is_bivalent_contr * prev_bivalent_contr * switch_contr + (1|id),
        family = "binomial",
        control = glmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa"),
        alt_cue)
  
}, dir = "dominik/models/", file = "alt_cue_error_contr_baseline.RDS", rerun = rerun_all)

alt_cue_error_contr_is_bivalent <- xfun::cache_rds({
  glmer(error ~ is_bivalent_contr * prev_bivalent_contr * switch_contr + (is_bivalent_contr|id),
        family = "binomial",
        control = glmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa"),
        alt_cue)
  
}, dir = "dominik/models/", file = "alt_cue_error_contr_is_bivalent.RDS", rerun = rerun_all)
anova(alt_cue_error_contr_baseline, alt_cue_error_contr_is_bivalent)

alt_cue_error_contr_prev_bivalent <- xfun::cache_rds({
  glmer(error ~ is_bivalent_contr * prev_bivalent_contr * switch_contr + (prev_bivalent_contr|id),
        family = "binomial",
        control = glmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa"),
        alt_cue)
  
}, dir = "dominik/models/", file = "alt_cue_error_contr_prev_bivalent.RDS", rerun = rerun_all)
anova(alt_cue_error_contr_baseline, alt_cue_error_contr_prev_bivalent)
## Data: alt_cue
## Models:
## alt_cue_error_contr_baseline: error ~ is_bivalent_contr * prev_bivalent_contr * switch_contr + (1 | id)
## alt_cue_error_contr_prev_bivalent: error ~ is_bivalent_contr * prev_bivalent_contr * switch_contr + (prev_bivalent_contr | id)
##                                   npar   AIC   BIC  logLik -2*log(L)  Chisq Df
## alt_cue_error_contr_baseline         9 17808 17885 -8894.8     17790          
## alt_cue_error_contr_prev_bivalent   11 17810 17904 -8893.9     17788 1.8129  2
##                                   Pr(>Chisq)
## alt_cue_error_contr_baseline                
## alt_cue_error_contr_prev_bivalent     0.4039
alt_cue_error_contr_switch <- xfun::cache_rds({
  glmer(error ~ is_bivalent_contr * prev_bivalent_contr * switch_contr + (switch_contr|id),
        family = "binomial",
        control = glmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa"),
        alt_cue)
  
}, dir = "dominik/models/", file = "alt_cue_error_contr_switch.RDS", rerun = rerun_all)
anova(alt_cue_error_contr_baseline, alt_cue_error_contr_switch)
## Data: alt_cue
## Models:
## alt_cue_error_contr_baseline: error ~ is_bivalent_contr * prev_bivalent_contr * switch_contr + (1 | id)
## alt_cue_error_contr_switch: error ~ is_bivalent_contr * prev_bivalent_contr * switch_contr + (switch_contr | id)
##                              npar   AIC   BIC  logLik -2*log(L)  Chisq Df
## alt_cue_error_contr_baseline    9 17808 17885 -8894.8     17790          
## alt_cue_error_contr_switch     11 17792 17887 -8885.3     17770 18.968  2
##                              Pr(>Chisq)    
## alt_cue_error_contr_baseline               
## alt_cue_error_contr_switch    7.606e-05 ***
## ---
## Signif. codes:  0 '***' 0.001 '**' 0.01 '*' 0.05 '.' 0.1 ' ' 1

So the model with the previous bivalent random effect doesn’t work. Can we combine switch and current bivalent? Yes!

alt_cue_error_contr_switch_is_bivalent <- xfun::cache_rds({
  glmer(error ~ is_bivalent_contr * prev_bivalent_contr * switch_contr + (switch_contr + is_bivalent_contr|id),
        family = "binomial",
        control = glmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa"),
        alt_cue)
  
}, dir = "dominik/models/", file = "alt_cue_error_contr_switch_is_bivalent.RDS", rerun = rerun_all)

Final model:

alt_cue_error_contr_final <- alt_cue_error_contr_switch_is_bivalent
make_model_table(alt_cue_error_contr_final)

6 DDM analysis

6.1 Aggregation and data processing

alt_cue_agg_ID_ddm <- alt_cue %>%
  mutate(RT_s = time/1000) %>%
  group_by(id, is_bivalent_contr, prev_bivalent_contr, switch_contr, cycle) %>%
  summarize(RT_log =  mean(time_log[filter_correct == 0], na.rm = TRUE),
            RT_s_m = mean(RT_s[filter_correct == 0], na.rm = TRUE),
            RT_s_var = var(RT_s[filter_correct == 0], na.rm = TRUE),
            Error = mean(error, na.rm = TRUE),
            N_trials = n()) %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(ezddm = list(ezddm(propCorrect = convert_extremes(1-Error), 
                            rtCorrectVariance_seconds = RT_s_var, 
                            rtCorrectMean_seconds = RT_s_m, 
                            nTrials = N_trials))) %>%
  unnest(ezddm)
## `summarise()` has grouped output by 'id', 'is_bivalent_contr',
## 'prev_bivalent_contr', 'switch_contr'. You can override using the `.groups`
## argument.
alt_cue_agg_ddm <- alt_cue_agg_ID_ddm %>%
  group_by(id, is_bivalent_contr, prev_bivalent_contr, switch_contr, cycle) %>%
  normWS(s = "id", dv = "a") %>%
  mutate(a = DV_n) %>%
  normWS(s = "id", dv = "v") %>%
  mutate(v = DV_n) %>%
  normWS(s = "id", dv = "Ter") %>%
  mutate(Ter = DV_n) %>%
  group_by(is_bivalent_contr, prev_bivalent_contr, switch_contr, cycle) %>%
  summarize(a_m = mean(a, na.rm = TRUE),
            a_ci_lower = get_ci(a, a_m)[1],
            a_ci_upper = get_ci(a, a_m)[2],
            v_m = mean(v, na.rm = TRUE),
            v_ci_lower = get_ci(v, v_m)[1],
            v_ci_upper = get_ci(v, v_m)[2],
            Ter_m = mean(Ter, na.rm = TRUE),
            Ter_ci_lower = get_ci(Ter, Ter_m)[1],
            Ter_ci_upper = get_ci(Ter, Ter_m)[2],)
## `summarise()` has grouped output by 'is_bivalent_contr', 'prev_bivalent_contr',
## 'switch_contr'. You can override using the `.groups` argument.

6.2 Statistical Models

6.2.1 First prep data so that it’s ignoring cycle

alt_cue_agg_ID_ddm_nocycle <- alt_cue %>%
  mutate(RT_s = time/1000) %>%
  group_by(id, is_bivalent_eff, is_bivalent_contr, prev_bivalent_eff, prev_bivalent_contr, switch_eff, switch_contr) %>%
  summarize(RT_log =  mean(time_log[filter_correct == 0], na.rm = TRUE),
            RT_s_m = mean(RT_s[filter_correct == 0], na.rm = TRUE),
            RT_s_var = var(RT_s[filter_correct == 0], na.rm = TRUE),
            Error = mean(error, na.rm = TRUE),
            N_trials = n()) %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(ezddm = list(ezddm(propCorrect = convert_extremes(1-Error), 
                            rtCorrectVariance_seconds = RT_s_var, 
                            rtCorrectMean_seconds = RT_s_m, 
                            nTrials = N_trials))) %>%
  unnest(ezddm)
## `summarise()` has grouped output by 'id', 'is_bivalent_eff',
## 'is_bivalent_contr', 'prev_bivalent_eff', 'prev_bivalent_contr', 'switch_eff'.
## You can override using the `.groups` argument.
alt_cue_agg_ddm_nocycle <- alt_cue_agg_ID_ddm_nocycle %>%
  group_by(id, is_bivalent_contr, prev_bivalent_contr, switch_contr) %>%
  normWS(s = "id", dv = "a") %>%
  mutate(a = DV_n) %>%
  normWS(s = "id", dv = "v") %>%
  mutate(v = DV_n) %>%
  normWS(s = "id", dv = "Ter") %>%
  mutate(Ter = DV_n) %>%
  group_by(is_bivalent_contr, prev_bivalent_contr, switch_contr) %>%
  summarize(a_m = mean(a, na.rm = TRUE),
            a_ci_lower = get_ci(a, a_m)[1],
            a_ci_upper = get_ci(a, a_m)[2],
            v_m = mean(v, na.rm = TRUE),
            v_ci_lower = get_ci(v, v_m)[1],
            v_ci_upper = get_ci(v, v_m)[2],
            Ter_m = mean(Ter, na.rm = TRUE),
            Ter_ci_lower = get_ci(Ter, Ter_m)[1],
            Ter_ci_upper = get_ci(Ter, Ter_m)[2],)
## `summarise()` has grouped output by 'is_bivalent_contr', 'prev_bivalent_contr'.
## You can override using the `.groups` argument.

6.2.2 Plots

plt_ddm_a <- ggplot(alt_cue_agg_ddm, aes(x = cycle, y = a_m, color = is_bivalent_contr, linetype = prev_bivalent_contr, group = interaction(is_bivalent_contr, prev_bivalent_contr)))+
  geom_line(position = pos)+
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = a_ci_lower, ymax = a_ci_upper), width = 0.1, position = pos)+
  theme_classic()

plt_ddm_v <- ggplot(alt_cue_agg_ddm, aes(x = cycle, y = v_m, color = is_bivalent_contr, linetype = prev_bivalent_contr, group = interaction(is_bivalent_contr, prev_bivalent_contr)))+
  geom_line(position = pos)+
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = v_ci_lower, ymax = v_ci_upper), width = 0.1, position = pos)+
  theme_classic()


plt_ddm_Ter <- ggplot(alt_cue_agg_ddm, aes(x = cycle, y = Ter_m, color = is_bivalent_contr, linetype = prev_bivalent_contr, group = interaction(is_bivalent_contr, prev_bivalent_contr)))+
  geom_line(position = pos)+
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = Ter_ci_lower, ymax = Ter_ci_upper), width = 0.1, position = pos)+
  theme_classic()

7 RT residual analysis

7.1 Effect coded valence (-0.5, 0.5)

7.1.1 Removed subject intercepts - removed from output

alt_cue_rt_log_resrt_eff <- xfun::cache_rds({
  lmer(time_log_res ~ is_bivalent_eff * prev_bivalent_eff * switch_contr * lag1_time_log_res + (is_bivalent_eff + switch_contr + prev_bivalent_eff + lag1_time_log_res | id), 
       control = lmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa"),
       alt_cue %>% 
         filter(filter_correct == 0))
  
}, dir = "dominik/models/", file = "alt_cue_rt_log_resrt_eff.RDS", rerun = rerun_all)

make_model_table(alt_cue_rt_log_resrt_eff)


preds <- emmeans::emmeans(alt_cue_rt_log_resrt_eff, ~ is_bivalent_eff * prev_bivalent_eff * switch_contr * lag1_time_log_res, type = "response",
                          at = list(is_bivalent_eff = factor(c(0, 1)),
                                    prev_bivalent_eff = factor(c(0, 1)),
                                    switch_contr = factor(c(0, 1)),
                                    lag1_time_log_res = c(-1.5, 1.5))) %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  mutate(speed = case_when(lag1_time_log_res == min(lag1_time_log_res) ~ "fast",
                           lag1_time_log_res == max(lag1_time_log_res) ~ "slow") %>% factor()) 



ggplot(preds, aes(x = switch_contr, y = emmean, color = is_bivalent_eff, linetype = prev_bivalent_eff, group = interaction(is_bivalent_eff, prev_bivalent_eff)))+
  geom_line(position = pos)+
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = asymp.LCL, ymax = asymp.UCL), position = pos)+
  scale_x_discrete(limits = c("1", "0"))+
  facet_wrap(~speed, labeller = labeller(speed = c("slow" = "lag RT slow",
                                                   "fast" = "lag RT fast")))+
  labs(title = "Model predictions for residual log RTs",
       y = "log(RT) prediction")+
  theme_classic()

7.1.2 Added subject intercepts

#For these analyses, we need to center the RTs:

         lag1_time_log_res_w_s_int_c = lag1_time_log_res_w_s_int - mean(lag1_time_log_res_w_s_int, na.rm = TRUE))

8 Individual differences analysis

alt_cue_indiv <- alt_cue_agg_ID_ddm_nocycle %>% 
  pivot_wider(id_cols = id, names_from = c(is_bivalent_contr, prev_bivalent_contr, switch_contr), 
              values_from = c(v, a, Ter, RT_log, Error), 
              names_glue = "{.value}_s{switch_contr}_cbiv{is_bivalent_contr}_lbiv{prev_bivalent_contr}") %>% 
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(v_s0_cbiv0_lbiv0_NA = ifelse(Ter_s0_cbiv0_lbiv0 < 0, NA, v_s0_cbiv0_lbiv0),

8.2 RT

RT_comparisons <- lapply(c("uu", "bu", "ub", "bb"), function(x){
  
  data.frame(model = compare_models(alt_cue_indiv_diff_models$RT, x)$model_names,
             comparison_p = compare_models(alt_cue_indiv_diff_models$RT, x)$comparison$`Pr(>F)`)
  
}) %>%
  bind_rows() %>%
  mutate(comparison_sig = ifelse(comparison_p < 0.05, 1, 0))


alt_cue_RT_model_summary <- lapply(alt_cue_indiv_diff_models$RT, function(x){
  m_sum <- x %>% 
    summary() 
  
  m_sum %>% 
    coef() %>% 
    as.data.frame() %>%
    mutate(r_sq = m_sum$r.squared,
           r_sq_adj = m_sum$adj.r.squared)
  
  
}) %>% 
  bind_rows(.id = "model") %>% 
  rownames_to_column("coefficient") %>%
  janitor::clean_names() %>%
  left_join(RT_comparisons) %>%
  mutate(coefficient = gsub("\\...[[:digit:]]+", "", coefficient),
         coefficient = gsub("RT_log_", "", coefficient),
         outcome = gsub("[[:digit:]]", "", model),
         is_sig = ifelse(pr_t < 0.05, 1, 0),
         r_label = as.character(round(r_sq, 2)),
         r_label = gsub("^0.", ".", r_label),
         r_label = case_when(comparison_sig == 1 ~ paste0(r_label, "*"), .default = r_label),
         r_adj_label = as.character(round(r_sq_adj, 2)),
         r_adj_label = gsub("^0.", ".", r_adj_label),
         r_adj_label = case_when(comparison_sig == 1 ~ paste0(r_adj_label, "*"), .default = r_adj_label))
## Joining with `by = join_by(model)`
ggplot(alt_cue_RT_model_summary, aes(x = coefficient, y = estimate, group = model, color = model))+ 
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dotted")+
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = estimate - std_error,
                  ymax = estimate + std_error), alpha = 0.1, color = NA)+
  geom_line()+
  geom_text(data = alt_cue_RT_model_summary %>% group_by(model) %>% slice(n()),
            aes(label = r_adj_label), hjust = -0.3)+
  geom_point(data = alt_cue_RT_model_summary %>% filter(is_sig == 1), pch = "*", size = 10)+
  theme_classic()+
  facet_wrap(~outcome, labeller = labeller(outcome = c("uu" = "uni-uni",
                                                       "ub" = "uni-bi",
                                                       "bu" = "bi-uni",
                                                       "bb" = "bi-bi")))+
  scale_x_discrete(labels = c("s0_cbiv0_lbiv1" = "NS\nL-bi\nC-uni",
                              "s0_cbiv1_lbiv1" = "NS\nL-bi\nC-bi",
                              "s0_cbiv0_lbiv0" = "NS\nL-uni\nC-uni",
                              "s0_cbiv1_lbiv0" = "NS\nL-uni\nC-bi",
                              "(Intercept)" = "Int"))+
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(1, 5.5))+
  theme(legend.position = "none")

## Joining with `by = join_by(model)`

  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dotted")+
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = estimate - std_error,
                  ymax = estimate + std_error), alpha = 0.1, color = NA)+

  geom_text(data = alt_cue_Error_model_summary %>% group_by(model) %>% slice(n()),
            aes(label = r_adj_label), hjust = -0.3)+
  geom_point(data = alt_cue_Error_model_summary %>% filter(is_sig == 1), pch = "*", size = 10)+
  theme_classic()+
  facet_wrap(~outcome, labeller = labeller(outcome = c("uu" = "uni-uni",
                                                       "ub" = "uni-bi",
                                                       "bu" = "bi-uni",
                                                       "bb" = "bi-bi")))+
  scale_x_discrete(labels = c("Error_s0_cbiv0_lbiv1" = "NS\nL-bi\nC-uni",

  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(1, 5.5))+

8.4 v

v_comparisons <- lapply(c("uu", "bu", "ub", "bb"), function(x){
  
  data.frame(model = compare_models(alt_cue_indiv_diff_models$v, x)$model_names,
             comparison_p = compare_models(alt_cue_indiv_diff_models$v, x)$comparison$`Pr(>F)`)
  
}) %>%
  bind_rows() %>%
  mutate(comparison_sig = ifelse(comparison_p < 0.05, 1, 0))



alt_cue_v_model_summary <- lapply(alt_cue_indiv_diff_models$v, function(x){
  m_sum <- x %>% 
    summary() 
  
  m_sum %>% 
    coef() %>% 
    as.data.frame() %>%
    mutate(r_sq = m_sum$r.squared,
           r_sq_adj = m_sum$adj.r.squared)
}) %>% 
  bind_rows(.id = "model") %>% 
  rownames_to_column("coefficient") %>%
  janitor::clean_names() %>%
  left_join(v_comparisons) %>%
  mutate(coefficient = gsub("\\...[[:digit:]]+", "", coefficient),
         coefficient = gsub("RT_log_", "", coefficient),
         outcome = gsub("[[:digit:]]", "", model),
         is_sig = ifelse(pr_t < 0.05, 1, 0),
         r_label = as.character(round(r_sq, 2)),
         r_label = gsub("^0.", ".", r_label),
         r_label = case_when(comparison_sig == 1 ~ paste0(r_label, "*"), .default = r_label),
         r_adj_label = as.character(round(r_sq_adj, 2)),
         r_adj_label = gsub("^0.", ".", r_adj_label),
         r_adj_label = case_when(comparison_sig == 1 ~ paste0(r_adj_label, "*"), .default = r_adj_label))
